verdict.rationale: Ramp documents running multiple entities in a single consolidated account, with per-entity spend policies and controls [ramp-docs-42]. It also syncs transaction and reimbursement data to multiple entities in one step [ramp-docs-24], and exposes entities as a data object to agents and the API [ramp-supp-ai-agents-channels, ramp-probe-4]. Multi-currency support is evidenced only for employee reimbursements (40 currencies) [ramp-docs-14], and consolidated cross-entity reporting is not explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit multi-currency entity accounts and books, documented consolidated reporting across entities, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
